The '''Freelands''' were open lands on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkinnea]]. During the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]], a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] made a camp south of the Freelands.
